In detail

The City of Kraków's own official resident-safety survey (conducted end of 2022, published January 2023 on the city's krakow.pl portal) found Krowodrza to be the second-best-rated district in the city, with 87.6% of its residents describing their district as safe — among the strongest results of any district in an official, city-run survey. No specific negative incident coverage was found for this district in any source checked. Sources checked: City of Kraków official resident-safety survey, krakow.pl (published January 2023).
